subject.title: [Bug]: non_deliverable_terminal_turn produces no outbound notification to channel plugins — Octo (and other channels) go silent

question: Should `non_deliverable_terminal_turn` reach channel plugins through a core automatic outbound fallback, a new plugin SDK terminal-failure hook, or plugin-owned handling only?
rationale: Each viable fix changes a user-visible channel delivery contract, and the issue is already marked as needing maintainer/product direction before automation should choose the permanent boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrow core fallback
options.body: Core sends one sanitized fallback for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns so existing and future SDK channels avoid silent sessions by default.

options.title: Add a plugin SDK terminal hook
options.body: OpenClaw documents a terminal-failure callback so channel plugins control wording and delivery, accepting new public API surface and per-plugin adoption work.

options.title: Leave recovery plugin-owned
options.body: Core keeps `message_tool_only` strict and expects Octo or other plugins to inspect run state or implement their own recovery loop.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core fallback
recommendation.body: Core sends one sanitized fallback for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns so existing and future SDK channels avoid silent sessions by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history is on the auto-reply/fallback delivery files whose behavior would change.
